passages.text: Remember to me, my God, for good, all that I have done for this people.
passages.note: Feeling unseen or unthanked for service to others

passages.text: I am doing a great work, so that I can’t come down. Why should the work cease, while I leave it, and come down to you?
passages.note: Staying focused on important work despite distractions

passages.text: There are no such things done as you say, but you imagine them out of your own heart.
